method: Deterministic zero/noise-free service diagnostics at explicitly different physical or calibrated-code levels; no fitted device curve or random error.
qualification: Execution success is not a common accuracy pass. Nominal diagnostics, timing arithmetic, analog nonidealities and workload accuracy remain separate.

model.source: SACIM-03 binary charge-coupled cell; independent bit planes and signed digital reconstruction
model.claim_boundary: Only already-calibrated ideal integer partial sums, grouping, finite signed reconstruction and nominal ADC code-count sufficiency are exercised. Missing physical voltage/current-to-code transfer and calibration thresholds are not invented; no analog ADC quantization or device accuracy claim.

nominal_code_capacity_check.meaning: Code-count necessity only; no claim that analog class voltages or margins are resolved.

cases.finding: No ideal encoding/decoding bias in the tested categories. Physical nominal ADC quantization remains unresolved; zero code-level residuals are not analog validation.

adc_code_convention.rounding: nearest integer; ties toward +infinity, implemented as floor(value/step+0.5)
adc_code_convention.endpoint_clipping: Clamp rounded raw code to0..1023;25uA gives raw1024 then clips to1023.
adc_code_convention.reference_calibration: 10368 units at2nA=20.736uA -> code849; gain=round_half_up((10368/849)*2**16) in Q8.16; each decoded partial is rounded half-up before radix/sign reconstruction.

nominal_code_capacity_check.meaning: Code-count necessity only; no claim that analog class voltages or margins are resolved.
nominal_code_capacity_check.interpretation: The nominal10bit ADC represents approximate current, not every integer unit count; no14bit ADC requirement is inferred.

restricted_offset_encoding_comparison.meaning: Numerical encoding comparison only. Original offset organization is excluded from automatic general signed-workload mapping and is not the selected reference.

cases.finding: Separated magnitudes remove the offset-created zero bias. Finite range resolution still loses sparse units and can dominate small residuals after cancellation; no universal relative-error guarantee.
